summary: Gas-fueled burners in the ACME BRE experiment showed steady flames in microgravity without airflow in elevated-oxygen atmospheres, while flames in 21% oxygen self-extinguished. This suggests ventilation shutoff may not stop fires in oxygen-rich spacecraft.
rationale: The work maps flammability and extinction limits, and notes that ventilation shutoff, a standard fire-suppression step, may fail in elevated oxygen.
